changes.description: Commit 7bd437b (2026-11-02): add https://nidhi-gaurd-gamma.vercel.app to CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS in backend/app/main.py for the Vercel/Render deployment; also adds the missing trailing newline. No other source change.

Phase 2.1: shared in-process cache for the expensive intelligence results (dataset, risk, relationships, geography). dependencies.py serves results from backend/app/intelligence/cache.py; csv_ingestion.py invalidates the cache after a committed ingestion; main.py starts an optional background warm-up. Intelligence algorithms, weights, thresholds, auth, RBAC and the investigation workflow are unchanged.

purpose: Append-only ledger of source changes made AFTER the V2.6 release. The V2.6 manifest is immutable; each entry here declares exact path, change type, base hash and new hash. Entries are hash-chained (previous_entry_sha256 -> entry_sha256, the first chaining to the pinned V2.6 manifest). Never edit an existing entry; append a new one.
